intervention: Additional character 1..5-gram counts; one occurrence per translation/near-duplicate family. Existing vocabulary and all other scorers stay frozen.
selection: Require aggregate top1 and top5 on both existing validation sets to be no lower than baseline; require new Tatoeba top1/top5 no lower than baseline. Maximize mean MRR of the three sets, tie prefer lower weight. Baseline remains an option.
acceptance: Selected setting must retain top1/top5 on old600, daily32, completion16 and natural200 regressions. Evaluate new heldout200 only after selection; require no lower top1/top5. If any guard fails, keep bundled model unchanged and retain experiment for review.
release: No APK or version bump for an inconclusive or rejected experiment. Existing 1.0 gate still applies; Tatoeba community examples do not establish modern HK chat accuracy.
limits: Heuristic family split does not establish independent authors; examples can be translated and unnatural. No private user text or uploaded conversations are used. There is no sentence-level correctness guarantee.
